results.title: Stock under Rs 300 in focus as company's revenue rises 24.6% YoY to Rs 511 crore, check share price
results.description: Shares of hospital chain operator Park Medi World are in focus after the company announced its financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026-27. The company reported a 24.58 per cent year-on-year (YoY) increase in consolidated revenue from operations to Rs 511.03 crore for the second quarter, up from Rs 410.20 crore in Q2 FY26. Sequentially, operational revenue rose 7.42 per cent from Rs 475.71 crore in Q1 FY27. However, the consolidated net profit (Profit After Tax) declined 30.81 per cent YoY to Rs 54.46 crore, down from Rs 78.70 crore in the year-ago period, and fell 38.47 per cent quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) from Rs 88.51 crore. Net profit attributable to the owners of the parent company stood at Rs 52.19 crore, compared to Rs 73.73 crore in Q2 FY26 and Rs 82.60 crore in Q1 FY27.

results.title: This 6-lane bridge in Bihar to be known as 'Nitish Setu'; PM Modi to inaugurate on November 21
results.description: The Kacchi Dargah-Raghopur-Bidupur six-lane bridge in Bihar will be named as “Nitish Setu” after Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, announced Deputy Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will dedicate the bridge to the nation on November 21. In a post on X, Chaudhary said, "Honourable Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be visiting Bihar on November 21. On this occasion, the Honourable Prime Minister will dedicate to the nation the six-lane Kacchi Dargah–Raghopur–Bidupur Bridge, which the state government has named ‘Nitish Setu’. The Honourable Prime Minister will also lay the foundation stones for and inaugurate various public welfare and development projects during the event in Rajapakar."

results.title: Amritpal Singh gets 1-day interim bail to attend grandmother's last rites
results.description: Amritpal Singh, MP from Khadoor Sahib, has been granted one-day interim bail by a local court. This bail allows him to attend the cremation of his grandmother, Charan Kaur, who recently passed away. His uncle, Harjeet Singh, and a relative, Sukhman Singh, received three and two days' bail, respectively. The exact time of Amritpal's arrival in Amritsar or flight details are still not confirmed.
